lines.name: vo_intro_pub
lines.text: [delighted] Ooh, shiny! [chuckles] Love the passion, kid. Now let's trim the fat so we can actually ship this thing.

lines.name: vo_intro_ron
lines.text: [determined] This is my vision, my game! And I will fight for it.

lines.name: vo_cut1_pub
lines.text: Focus group says the art is... distracting. [smug] Minimalism is trending anyway!

lines.name: vo_cut1_ron
lines.text: [dry] Good thing the hitboxes still work.

lines.name: vo_cut2_pub
lines.text: Neon? In this economy? [laughs] Grey-box is the new gritty!

lines.name: vo_cut2_ron
lines.text: [deadpan] It's a PC game, man.

lines.name: vo_cut3_pub
lines.text: Animation is pure vanity. [grandly] Call it... avant-garde!

lines.name: vo_cut3_ron
lines.text: [incredulous] You are joking, right? It is not what I wanted to create!

lines.name: vo_cut4_pub
lines.text: Pure mechanics! Zero bloat! [triumphant] Behold... the Minimum Viable Product!

lines.name: vo_cut4_ron
lines.text: [calm] You can't patch out muscle memory, fat guy.

lines.name: vo_stun_pub
lines.text: [panicked] Wait, wait! Keep the neon! Keep the sword! Full creative control, I swear!

lines.name: vo_final_ron
lines.text: [shouting] Patch notes: you're out!

lines.name: vo_final_pub
lines.text: [wheezing] My... bonus...

lines.name: vo_bark_1_pub
lines.text: [annoyed] Per my last email!

lines.name: vo_bark_2_pub
lines.text: Let's pivot!

lines.name: vo_bark_3_pub
lines.text: [scoffs] Too niche!

lines.name: vo_bark_4_pub
lines.text: Think of the shareholders!

lines.name: vo_steal_shuriken
lines.text: Ranged damage. [delighted] Finally, a feature I can monetise.

lines.name: vo_steal_parry
lines.text: Blocking? [chuckles] I've been blocking ideas for twenty years.

lines.name: vo_steal_dash_pub
lines.text: Dash? [smug] It'll be available behind a paywall.

lines.name: vo_steal_dash_ron
lines.text: [deadpan] It's a basic mechanic, bro.

lines.name: vo_steal_ultimate
lines.text: [grandly] Your big finale is now my DLC.

lines.name: vo_comic_1_pub
lines.text: [delighted] Great news, kid! We ship TODAY!

lines.name: vo_comic_2_ron
lines.text: [panicked] Today?! It's not finished!

lines.name: vo_comic_3_pub
lines.text: [impatient] Enough! No time, no budget. [menacing] I'll cut what we don't need... personally.

lines.name: vo_comic_4_ron
lines.text: [quietly determined] Then I'll fight for every pixel.

lines.name: vo_banter_1_pub
lines.text: [cheerful] Just put a "Day One Patch" on the roadmap!

lines.name: vo_banter_1_ron
lines.text: [flat] No.

lines.name: vo_banter_2_pub
lines.text: [annoyed] Why are you dodging? Hit your KPIs!

lines.name: vo_banter_2_ron
lines.text: [dry] I'm fixing your bugs.

lines.name: vo_banter_3_pub
lines.text: [conspiratorial] Hear me out... what if we add a battle pass?

lines.name: vo_banter_3_ron
lines.text: [cold] Over my dead build.

lines.name: vo_banter_4_pub
lines.text: [excited] Have you considered... NFTs?

lines.name: vo_banter_4_ron
lines.text: [warning] Don't finish that sentence.

lines.name: vo_banter_5_pub
lines.text: [enthusiastic] Needs more loot boxes! Players love surprises!

lines.name: vo_banter_5_ron
lines.text: [menacing] You will be surprised soon.

lines.name: vo_banter_6_pub
lines.text: [outraged] Stop parrying! That's not in the design doc!

lines.name: vo_banter_6_ron
lines.text: [calm] I rewrote it.

lines.name: vo_banter_7_pub
lines.text: [whining] You're making this way too hard!

lines.name: vo_banter_7_ron
lines.text: [deadpan] Skill issue.

lines.name: vo_banter_8_pub
lines.text: [smug] You can't fight market trends!

lines.name: vo_banter_8_ron
lines.text: [determined] Watch me.
